title: TrendTag: Social Hashtag Trends
context: Social platforms surface trending hashtags and group spelling variants. All of it starts with counting and windows.
input: Posts as strings; tag ids with timestamps; reply-thread trees.

milestones.title: Most used tag
milestones.requirement: Counts per tag id; report the top tag.

milestones.title: Thread engagement
milestones.requirement: Total likes in a nested reply thread (post-order recursion).

milestones.title: Posts in any hours
milestones.requirement: Prefix sums over posts per hour.

milestones.title: Posts in a time window
milestones.requirement: Sorted timestamps: count posts in [t1, t2) with two lower bounds.

milestones.title: Top trends
milestones.requirement: k most frequent tags (bucket sort by frequency, or a heap).
